items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: Jimmy Rowkes came in. He was in that band with behind and Billy.

ctx.x: I went back and did the dates with the sextet in New York and when I came out, I went to Honolulu for four months, I came back, I went in there, Red wanted to leave to go with Charlie Barnett, so I had another bass player, so Jimmy Rowkes came in. He was in that band with behind and Billy. So Jimmy was setting there he said, "You having trouble finding a bass player, aren't you?" I said, "Yeah, I can't get the right one." He says, "You remember that fella who worked with us on the tour with Billie Holiday?" I…

So I started calling San Francisco, the union, and I called and and called and finally found him carrying mail in Los Angeles, he wasn't playing. I contacted him, he didn't really want to -- know if he wanted to come or not, he did though. And, oh he was just up in the air all the time, but he was the answer.
